lines: Flight Management System, Java Full stack Web development with React
github.com/name/repo
Flight management system is a web-based application which gives user and admin access according to their roles.
- User can register/login, view/edit personal details and book the flights while
- Admin can register/login, view customer list, add/update/delete customer details, airports, flights and view
bookings.
- Implemented backend using Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate and PostgreSQL.
- Implemented frontend using React,HTML, CSS, Bootstrap.
Third Party API to Fetch JSON Data,Java Full Stack

- Integrated third-party JSON data fetching to populate and sync dynamic content.
- Developed a user-friendly UI for Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations on database entries.
- Ensured seamless interaction between frontend and backend using RESTful APIs.
- Tools and Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate Search, H2 Database, React.js, HTML, CSS, Swagger
(API documentation), Mockito (unit testing)
